subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Pig Butchering: The Long-Game Scam
description: A 60-second lesson on Pig Butchering: The Long-Game Scam.

hook.text: A new online friend introduces you to a crypto investment platform. Your money grows. Then it vanishes.

buildup.text: Pig butchering means 'fattening' victims with fake profits before stealing everything.

discovery.text: The investment platform is fake. The profits on screen are fake. Only your deposits are real.

twist.text: Many scammers are themselves trafficking victims, forced to run these scams in overseas compounds.

climax.text: Pig butchering scams stole over $3.3 billion in 2022, making them the fastest-growing fraud type.

punchline.text: They fatten your confidence. Then they butcher your savings.

quiz.question: What makes pig butchering scams unique?
options: Victims are shown fake profits to encourage larger deposits
